paragraphs: 💻 Motivated MERN Stack Software Engineer with a passion for building responsive and dynamic full-stack web applications. 🛠️ Skilled in modern frontend and backend technologies such as React.js, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB. 🅰️ Building modern Angular apps — standalone components, Signals, RxJS and Tailwind CSS (see the featured projects below). 🤝 Team player with strong problem-solving skills and a focus on writing clean, maintainable code following best practices. 🚀 Constantly exploring new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve performance and user experience.
features: A hands-on playground for learning Angular — 15 interactive lessons, each split into sections and closed by a quiz.
Final quiz per topic: 6 random questions, 75% to pass
Progress tracking and a dashboard with day streak and "Save for later"
Light & dark themes, command palette (⌘K), responsive with mobile bottom navigation
Built with standalone components, signals and the new control flow (no NgModules); tested and deployed to GitHub Pages with GitHub Actions
